channel.title: Doorbell Detectives
channel.desc: Cheryl turns doorbell detective when she discovers a dodgy duo taking her kid's bike from her garden, but with the help of other victims, do they manage to crack the case? Former police inspector Anton Sullivan dons a flat cap as he heads to the countryside to highlight rural crime. James loses his patience as his cameras capture numerous fly-tippers, and he eventually decides to confront them.
